#  41110 - PhD Research Seminar Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **41110 - Phase-out Module**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **PhD Research Seminar**  |  
|  PhD Forschungsseminar   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 2 - Environment and Natural Sciences   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr. habil. Wanner, Manfred 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 6 semesters  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every semester   |  
| Credits:  |  18   |  
| Learning Outcome:  | The class aims at giving an overview of the state of the PhD theses of participants. Aims, objectives, methods, work plan, and results of the thesis should be presented and afterwards critically discussed with fellow students in the presence of the first supervisors.  |  
| Contents:  | The content is changing each semester. It is defined by the contributions of the PhD-students who are due to present. The sequence of presentations is organized by the PhD administration in accordance with students and supervisors.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Seminar / 180 Hours 
  * Consultation / 90 Hours 
  * Self organised studies / 270 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | None  |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  1. Presentation, 15 min. (20%)
  2. Presentation, 15 min. (40%)
  3. Presentation, 15 min. (40%)

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | None  |  
| Module Components:  | 
  * 240799 Seminar Postgraduate Research Seminar
